title: AI Gateway routing and ground-truth budget telemetry
description: D17. All cloud model traffic goes through the operator AI Gateway in their own account, tagged with run and tick ids via gateway metadata headers, so spend is attributable per run. The Workflow reads GATEWAY logs for cost, never the agent self-report - an agent can misreport, an invoice cannot - and that number is what budget enforcement acts on. Include the kill switch: revoking or rotating a run gateway token stops a wedged or adversarial agent at the credential layer. tk factory setup already has a gateway rung; this tick wires the run path to it and makes the absence of a configured gateway an actionable stop at submission, never a silent fallback to a vendor default.

2026-08-19 20:58 - Verified against the operator's real Cloudflare account (2026-08-19), so build for this rather than an assumption:

WORKS — Workers AI is reachable with the factory token: GET /accounts/<acct>/ai/models/search returns success, including @cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b, exactly the open-weight class the economy/balanced tiers are meant to route to.

FAILS — AI Gateway is NOT reachable with that token: GET /accounts/<acct>/ai-gateway/gateways returns 10000 Authentication error. The token was minted without the AI Gateway permission. That is an operator fix (a token edit, not a re-mint), not a code fix.

Consequences for this tick:
1. A missing or unreachable gateway must be an ACTIONABLE STOP at submission naming what to add, never a silent fallback to a vendor default — a run that quietly bypasses the gateway has no cost telemetry and no kill switch, which are the two things this tick exists to provide.
2. Distinguish 'no gateway configured' from 'gateway configured but the credential cannot reach it' (10000). They have different fixes and the operator should be told which one they have.
3. Workers AI fronts through the gateway on the provider route https://gateway.ai.cloudflare.com/v1/<account>/<gateway>/workers-ai/... — cloud agents are CLIs making HTTP calls, not Workers using the env.AI binding, so the binding path does not apply here.
4. Workers AI speaks OpenAI-compatible shapes, so those tiers ride the pi/omp kind, not claude. If you touch tier routing, note that in the report — it is a kind change in runners.toml, not just a model string, and Phase 2 will otherwise assume wrongly.
acceptance_criteria: A run cannot start without a configured gateway, and the error names tk factory setup; every model request carries run and tick metadata; the runs row cost comes from gateway telemetry and not from the agent; revoking the run token stops model traffic mid-run, proven by a test.
